justification: LOINC code 4548-4 represents hemoglobin A1c, which should range from approximately 4-14% in clinical practice; a value of 6.14% is physiologically plausible, but the unit code '%' is incorrect for this measurement—hemoglobin A1c should use the unit '%' with UCUM code '%' or '%{HbA1c}', making this a data quality issue in the recorded slice.
